projects.name: Gapwise
projects.summary: Turn a financial goal into a weekly plan. Gapwise helps people build a $1,000 emergency fund by comparing savings milestones with their available cash flow.
projects.copy: Gapwise helps people work toward a financial goal: a $1,000 emergency fund. Our synthetic demo starts with $250 saved and compares weekly savings milestones. At $50 per week, the remaining $750 takes 15 weeks. Built for the fictional Fintech for Good hackathon; no bank connection or financial advice.

requirements.title: Explain the financial goal and savings milestones

evidence.note: Synthetic example: $1,000 emergency-fund goal, $250 already saved, $50 weekly contribution. The remaining $750 takes 15 weeks. No real financial information.
